'''Clan-General''' was a title in the [[Hutt Empire]]. Prior to the [[Xim Wars]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]] was appointed as a Clan-General by the first [[Conclave of Worms]].
